contextEntries.title: Target market
contextEntries.content: International discovery platform, initially Spain (Catalonia + Valencia), Spanish and English. MVP covers rental/amateur and competitive karting, tracks, schools, teams, training, camps, and competitions.

contextEntries.title: Backend architecture
contextEntries.content: ASP.NET Core modular monolith, PostgreSQL with PostGIS for geospatial queries (tracks, schools, event locations).

contextEntries.title: Frontend architecture
contextEntries.content: Next.js + TypeScript, CSS Modules, Radix UI where needed.

contextEntries.title: Future phases
contextEntries.content: Phase 2: community features, driver profiles, team finder. Phase 3: results, history, and rankings.

decisions.title: Use PostgreSQL with PostGIS
decisions.rationale: Tracks, schools, and events all need geospatial queries (nearest track, radius search); PostGIS is the standard extension for this on PostgreSQL.

decisions.title: Use Next.js for the frontend
decisions.rationale: Server-rendered pages for SEO (karting discovery is a search-driven use case), TypeScript for type safety across the team.

handoffs.title: Implement championship domain
handoffs.objective: Implement the approved domain model for Kartimo's championship tracking.
